RAM Promaster Cargo Van – Commercial Partial Wrap

It’s 2021 and a fresh new chapter in everyone’s journey to a successful Business. Vinyl Wrap Toronto Wishes everyone a very happy new year! Most people start to prepare to set their goals by the end of the year so they can enter the new year all set to work towards achieving them. One of our recent clients “N.E.G. Inc”; a business that provides audio, visual, lighting and CCTV services wanted to start the year 2021 on the right foot. Which is by investing in something to promote their business.

Considering the technological advancement, there are countless ways they could’ve advertised their business. But which one is the best? To figure that out they had to ask themselves the following questions:

  1. How much to spend?
  2. How long do you want the advertisement to last?
  3. What is the target audience?
  4. What is the nature of our business?
  5. What will give the best return?
  6. Which market to advertise in; Online, Paper-Based, Billboards?

The client owns a RAM Promaster Cargo Van which they use to carry out their daily business duties. Considering the pros of getting a vehicle wrap, the client decided to get a partial van wrap for their RAM Promaster Cargo Van to advertise their business. The client was very specific about what was required as the outcome and supplied their own design. Our designers converted the design into a digital mockup which we could use to print the design onto the best quality printable material provided by Avery Dennison. Vinyl Wrap Toronto only uses the best quality wrap material offered by 3M and Avery Dennison because when it comes to our clients’ pride and joys, there are to be no compromises.

After the printing and lamination process, it was passed on to our expert installers who do the real magic and put the vinyl onto the vehicles. This was a partial wrap with decals because the customer still wanted the original white colour on the van. The wrap covers more than half of both sides and the back of the RAM Promaster Cargo Van. We’ve attached pictures of the RAM Promaster Cargo Van on this page for you to see what it turned out to look like.

When you’re getting commercial wraps and decals, our experts have the following advice to give you:

  1. Keep It Simple – Less is more; especially when it’s something that’s supposed to be read while driving.
  2. Use an easy-to-read font.
  3. Keep the font large enough so can be seen from a distance.
  4. Use colours that pop.
  5. Include contact information such as phone, email, and website.

If you have a RAM Promaster Cargo Van or any vehicle that you want to get wrapped, whether it is personal or commercial, give us a call at 416-746-1381 or visit our garage located at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, ON, M9W1B4 to speak to one of our experts about your requirements and get your van wrap cost.
